player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Gĩcunjĩ kĩa mĩgambo, rũtara kana gĩthũri kĩarĩ nja ya ũraihu.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Mũgambo ũcio no mũhaka ũhũrũo na kamũrango-inĩ karĩa gakinyaga.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: O na rĩu nĩ tũhootanĩte kĩharo-inĩ kĩu.

next_board.any: kĩbungo o gĩothe kĩa micro board
